step-tracker-marker.$description: Vertical StepTracker marker: a 22px square turned 45°.

step-tracker-bar-on.$description: Horizontal StepTracker: a reached segment. White on a pink field.

step-tracker-bar-off.$description: Horizontal StepTracker: a segment still to come. White at 25% on pink and ink fields.

step-tracker-marker-on.$description: Vertical StepTracker: a reached marker's diamond. White on a pink field, where pink would vanish (R89).

step-tracker-marker-off.$description: Vertical StepTracker: a marker still to come. White at 25% on a pink field, so it reads weaker than a reached one.

step-tracker-mark-on.$description: The brand mark and check inside a reached marker. Pink on a pink field (the diamond is white there).

step-tracker-mark-off.$description: The brand mark inside a marker still to come. White on a pink field.
